title: Functional universality of critical SK autocorrelations
summary: We prove that the stationary spin autocorrelation of the zero-field Sherrington–Kirkpatrick model at inverse temperature β = 1 has a common functional scaling limit for Gaussian and Rademacher couplings. With rate-one heat-bath clocks at every site, time is scaled by n 2/3 and the mean spin autocorrelation is multiplied by n 1/3 . The functions converge in law uniformly on compact positive-time intervals. Their limiting law is not a point mass: it retains sample-to-sample randomness, and its functions decay to zero at large times.
family_title: Critical SK autocorrelation processes and dynamics across the temperature transition

review.reason: Establishes a functional scaling limit for critical spin autocorrelations in the SK model.
